items.html: And the reason for this is that since they are the three first [Sefirot] of Arich Anpin, which are the phase of the head, and the head requires much more light than the body, therefore each one of them was clothed with one complete Sefira of Atik. But the seven lower [Sefirot], the body of Arich Anpin, do not require as much light as the head, and therefore the three last [Sefirot] of Atik suffice to illuminate them. And this is their order: the self of NHY of Atik is in HGT of Arich Anpin, as mentioned; and this is also because HGT of Arich Anpin later become Mochin in the three first [Sefirot] of Aba and Ima, and therefore the main of their illumination is in HGT of Arich Anpin, to illuminate the Mochin of Aba and Ima. And afterward, from the Yesod of Atik, only light came out and expanded in the NHY of Arich Anpin.
